name: hermes-doctor-mcp
description: Run a health check on an agent instance configuration.

tools.name: check_config
tools.description:
Run a health check on an agent instance configuration.

Verifies provider wiring, model defaults, persona document structure,
and MCP registry consistency. Returns a graded report (A-F) with findings.

tools.name: report_card
tools.description:
Fetch the latest graded report card for a previously checked instance.

Returns grade, findings, and recommendations.
